svg.title: Achaemenid Empire around 500 BC and guide locations
svg.desc: Natural terrain colors outside the empire, muted land beneath a translucent amber overlay, and blue water. The extent is adapted from the 500 BC reference map. Eighteen guide locations remain visible. Place markers span different periods.
svg.text: Approximate imperial extent and the places discussed in the field guide
Hollow dots: approximate site locations · † Nazareth: later Christian comparison
Relief: © Sémhur / Wikimedia Commons · 500 BC extent: Enyavar · CFM Corner adaptation · CC BY-SA 4.0
Shading indicates an approximate historical extent, not a surveyed border. Ancient shorelines could differ.
